items.headline: Dabo Swinney praises Clemson's toughness in win over Cal
items.description: Clemson coach Dabo Swinney came into the season unsure what to make of his team's toughness. On Friday night, some of those questions began to get answered in a 24-10 win at California.

items.headline: Bryant Wesco's punt return TD leads Clemson to a 24-10 win over Cal
items.description: — Bryant Wesco Jr. had Clemson's first punt return touchdown in eight years to break a tie late in the third quarter and the Tigers went on to beat California 24-10 Friday night in a game where both offenses struggled.
